messages:
mina.arch: Quick sync thread: I sketched an "ownership catalogue" approach to tame tech debt across service boundaries. Sharing short proposal + questions.
yusuf.eng: curious — what's the catalogue shape?
mina.arch: thinking minimal: list of public endpoints, owning team, fallback owner, migration window, outbound sync deps, preferred adapter pattern. Goal is to make extraction targets visible and measurable.
clare.pm: nice. will this block product roadmaps? need clarity on gating rules.
mina.arch: not intended to block. Proposal: tag endpoints as "extract-now" vs "defer". Only extract-now endpoints get the full runbook and canary schedule. Defer ones get a ticket and remediation timeframe.
yusuf.eng: measures? i want to see success metrics.
mina.arch: KPIs: # endpoints with single owner, avg sync-call per request, contract churn rate (weekly diffs), and % endpoints with adapters behind feature flags. Target: 30% reduction in inter-service sync calls in 3 months.
clare.pm: who maintains the catalogue? and how do we prevent it from going stale?
mina.arch: propose a small cadence: owners must confirm entries weekly for active extracts; infra publishes a weekly report run that flags stale entries and unassigned endpoints. We'll integrate with the service registry.
ops-bot: Action added: create weekly-catalogue-report job (owner: infra-team).
yusuf.eng: operationally, adapters are the trickiest. propose a template: small shim + golden-path replay harness + contract parity tests. keep PRs small and require a migration plan in PR description.
mina.arch: agree. also suggest an "extractable score" per endpoint (call freq, user impact, test coverage) to prioritize.
clare.pm: product asks: add a soft freeze calendar (no extractions during major launches) and a rollback SLA if user-visible regressions surface.
mina.arch: adding rollback SLA (1h route flip + hotfix window) and freeze calendar integration.
yusuf.eng: one more: add ownership for streaming endpoints specially — sticky sessions and session affinity need explicit notes.
mina.arch: will add a streaming section. thanks. I'll post the brief RFC and the initial catalogue template for review. tagging eng leads for a quick signoff tomorrow.
